name: minimax-h3

metadata.comment: V2 async task API. Pay-as-you-go list price $0.08/s at 768P and $0.13/s at 2K, plus $0.04 per input image beyond the first 5. Audio input is free. Reference video input is rejected, since MiniMax bills its duration only after the create call.

MiniMax official H3 generation family and multimodal input; pricing depends on resolution/media and is not flattened to per-token chat price
